name: evidence.enrichJunit
title: Enrich JUnit file
summary: Add UUID, version, item and date, and the variant's UUID when there is one, to every test case of a JUnit XML file that names an element by short ID, UUID or identifier, or by a short ID in another form that a name pattern finds. Test cases with an unknown reference, or whose variant does not fit, stay unchanged and are listed; the CLI exits 1. The output counts the test cases that name no element.
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes the current versions of the elements, which depend on the metamodel (which properties count).

file.description: The JUnit XML file to enrich. It is rewritten in place unless `output` is given. A test case that already has a `reqseq:version` is never changed (D-026).

item.description: The item under test, for example the build. No white space at either end and no control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return.

date.description: The date of the test run. Default: an existing `reqseq:date` of the test case, else the `timestamp` of its test suite when that has a time zone, else the time of the call.

variant.description: The variant the test run was for (an element whose type has the meaning variant): each enriched test case gets its UUID as `reqseq:variant`. Absent: a test case keeps its own `reqseq:variant`, if any, whose short ID or identifier becomes the UUID; `core` is none, but is checked like a variant (a record without variant counts in the core, and in every view the element applies in when its repository is marked `variant-independent`, SR-173). A test case that names another variant, or names an element that does not count in its variant (not valid there, excluded or replaced, as at `evidence.record`), stays unchanged and gets `evidence.invalid-record`; so does an enriched test case (never changed, D-026) whose variant differs from the given one.

namePattern.description: A template that finds a short ID written in another form in test case names, for names that cannot hold brackets, e.g. `{prefix}_{id}_ak{ak}` for `sr_348143_ak1` (SR-348143). `{prefix}` is a type prefix of the metamodel, `{id}` 6 to 32 hex digits, `{ak}` 1 to 9 digits (ignored); `{prefix}` and `{id}` once each, `{ak}` once at most and not next to `{id}`. The rest is literal text; `{{` and `}}` are braces, square brackets are refused. All of it is ASCII case-insensitive. A match starts and ends at a word boundary (the start or end of the name, a character that is not a letter or digit, or the start of a camel case word) and is looked for in the name outside `[...]` only, not in the class name. It adds to the bracket form and the `reqseq:element` property; a short ID it finds that names no element, or several, is listed in `unknown`.

output.description: Default: overwrite the input file. An existing file is replaced only when it is a JUnit XML file the scanner accepts; its folder must exist.

testCases.description: The test cases that name at least one element and are enriched: by this call, or already before.

withoutReference.description: The test cases that name no element: no `reqseq:element` property and no name token or pattern match that names one (a pytest parameter list counts here). Test cases enriched already, listed in `unknown` or refused are not counted. Information only: it does not change the exit code.

unknown.description: Each reference that names no element or more than one, with its test case; that test case stays unchanged.

line.description: The line of the `<testcase>` in the file as read.

files.description: The written file, relative to the workspace root (the folder of the main repository) with `/` when it lies below it or in another repository of the workspace, else its absolute path. None when nothing is written: nothing to change in place, or `output` holds these bytes already; a given `output` is otherwise written even when nothing changes.
